description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT LAKE VIEW ROAD OF KOSOVARI WITH LAKE VIEW. THE APARTMENT IS LOCATED ON THE 5TH RESIDENTIAL FLOOR. IT HAS A REGULAR FLOOR FLOOR. ORGANIZED: DISTRIBUTOR CORRIDOR, A SMALL STORAGE, TWO BEDROOMS, TOILET. KITCHEN LIVING ROOM WITH VERANDA. THE AREA OFFERS ALL THE NECESSARY FACILITIES FOR A COMFORTABLE LIFE NEAR THE ARTIFICIAL PARK AND THE TIRANA LAKE. ALSO AVAILABLE A PARKING POST AT ~3 WITH AN EXTRA PRICE OF 40K.
